representativeSnapshot.kind: isolated production-like Supabase branch required before promotion

rowCountQueries: select count(*) from public.venue_profiles where contact_info is not null and jsonb_strip_nulls(contact_info) <> '{}'::jsonb
select count(*) from public.venue_profiles where settings is not null and jsonb_typeof(settings -> 'amenities') = 'object'
preflight.expectedAffectedRows: Adds the nullable postal_code field when absent, fills only empty canonical location fields from contact_info, and merges only truthy legacy amenity keys into the existing canonical array

execution.resumeStrategy: Transactional re-issue or an additive forward-fix after isolated rehearsal
execution.idempotency: Postal-code capture uses IF NOT EXISTS; location updates fill only empty targets; amenity normalization is deterministic and updates only distinct arrays

quarantine.strategy: Do not infer tenant ownership; stop and quarantine unresolved rows before any backfill

constraints: venue_profiles.postal_code remains nullable so absent source data is not fabricated
venue_profiles top-level location and amenities remain canonical while JSON sources are preserved for rollback
constraintsAndIndexes.validationPlan: Fresh-chain rehearsal, conflict and unmerged-key counts, representative location normalization fixtures, and a second execution yielding no additional updates

recovery.rollback: Prefer flag-off rollback; use an additive compensating migration for persisted schema changes
recovery.forwardFix: Ship a later additive migration after preserving unresolved records and evidence

queries: Read-only object, row-count, RLS, grant, constraint, and advisor checks must be captured
